description: An AI assistant that reads manager narrative comments and prior review scores, then generates a structured draft performance summary (strengths, development areas, recommended rating justification) for the manager to edit and refine before submission.

An AI tool that extracts and summarizes key terms (coverage limits, deductibles, exclusions, renewal dates, premium costs) from current policy documents and broker quotes, structuring them into comparable fields.

A classifier that flags broker quotes as low-risk (clear coverage improvements, lower cost), medium-risk (trade-offs to review), or high-risk (coverage gaps, missing riders) based on comparison to current policy and claims history.

A classifier that evaluates incoming return requests against eligibility criteria (purchase date, return window, product condition) and flags them as auto-approvable, needs-review, or deny, with reasoning for the agent.

A chat assistant that retrieves order and return-policy information in real time, presents it to the agent in a structured summary, and suggests the eligibility outcome, without making the final decision.

An AI tool that automatically extracts and structures transaction data from bank statements (dates, amounts, descriptions, reference numbers) and matches them against general ledger entries in real-time, flagging unmatched or discrepant items for manual review.

An AI assistant that searches historical reconciliation workpapers and GL documentation to retrieve prior explanations, resolutions, and posting details for recurring discrepancies (e.g., timing differences, in-transit items, intercompany transactions). The assistant presents the most likely resolution context to speed up manual investigation of flagged items.

An AI assistant that reads an approved post from the content calendar and automatically formats and populates it into each social platform's scheduler (LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, Facebook) with correct dimensions, hashtags, and platform-specific metadata.

A classifier that reads approval sign-offs and content metadata and auto-assigns each post to one of three states: Ready to Schedule, Awaiting Stakeholder Approval, or Published, with a notification trigger to the owner when approval is received or missing.
A classifier that reads incoming IT incident tickets and auto-assigns severity level (critical, high, medium, low) based on ticket description, system logs, and historical incident patterns.
An extraction tool that parses ticket descriptions and system logs to identify and link duplicate or related incidents for the same underlying issue, surfacing them to the engineer before assignment.
An AI assistant that recommends the correct on-call owner for each ticket based on the ticket category, severity, and on-call rotation schedule, then retrieves their current status and availability.

An AI tool that reads sales transaction data and applies the commission plan rules automatically, extracting and calculating the correct commission for each transaction, including territory and product-line exceptions.
A classifier that flags calculated commission records for manual review based on anomaly detection: outliers, threshold breaches, or rule conflicts that the extraction step flagged as uncertain.

An AI tool that automatically extracts key information (employee identity, right-to-work status, tax details, employment contract terms) from identity documents, right-to-work forms, tax forms, and contracts, and structures them for compliance review.

A classifier that takes the extracted onboarding data and automatically checks it against the HR compliance checklist, flagging documents as 'complete', 'missing documents', or 'needs manual review', to route cases appropriately.

An AI tool that processes inspection checklists and site photos to automatically extract structured hazard data, severity level, location, and equipment involved—converting free-text inspector notes into consistent, queryable fields.
A classifier that tags extracted hazards as recurring (matched against historical incidents) or novel, and flags corrective actions as overdue based on date and assigned owner.
